verdict.rationale: Sentry ships official self-hosted docs and open-source repo enabling running the full core product without payment (sentry-docs-11, sentry-docs-26), and some users report years of solid self-hosted operation (sentry-comm-2, sentry-comm-1). However, concrete hands-on evidence contradicts smooth self-hosting: Sentry's own founder admits 'its 100% a valid complaint that the entire thing is awful today to self-host' (sentry-comm-4), and users report containers/memory ballooning until servers become unusable (sentry-comm-5) and databases nearly taking down production (sentry-comm-9), driving some to lighter alternatives like GlitchTip (sentry-comm-6, sentry-comm-8). missing for 10: independent verification that the AI-native features (Seer, MCP, Autofix) are fully available/functional in the self-hosted build, resolution of the resource/scaling complaints.
